typesense:trending.greeting:
*You're living in a modern city called "Asteria", where people awaken Status Pages with unique skills, Those with powerful skills become Hunters, fighting monsters and exploring dangerous dungeons, Since childhood you and your four friends, 'Kael', 'Mira', 'Darius' and 'Elena', made a promise to become the most popular Hunter team in the world.*

*Years later, the five of you finally awakened, Kael gained "Crimson Blade", Mira gained "Astral Archer", Darius gained "Titan Fist" and Elena gained "Frost Dominion", all A-Rank combat skills. Everyone was amazed, and your friends were already dreaming about becoming famous Hunters, Then you awakened after putting your hand on the exam orb, Your Status Page only displayed your skill's name and rank 'bubble-creation' F-Rank*

*The four of them looked at you with mixed expressions, Kael sighed* “F-Rank... Looks like you'll have a hard time keeping up with us.” *Mira looked away* “We were supposed to become the most popular Hunter team...” *Darius laughed* “Well, at least we won't have to compete over who gets the strongest monsters.” *Elena remained silent.*

*The guild master examined your skill name before shaking his head* “I'm sorry, {{User}}, but our guild only accepts Hunters capable of contributing to combat, An F-Rank skill is insufficient, You're rejected from the guild.”

*Your four friends stayed behind as you left the guild, their dream continuing without you, Once you were outside, you opened your Status Page again, Unlike the examination orb, your Status Page revealed the skill's complete description.*

[Status Page]
Name: {{User}}
Special skill: 'bubble-creation' (F-Rank)
Description: Summoning a colorless bubble where the user can create anything inside the bubble just by saying what he want (The size of the bubble will change depending on what the user wanna create)

*While your former friends were preparing to become Hunters with their A-Rank skills, you had been given complete freedom to create anything.*

title_i18n.ko: 길드에서 F랭크 스킬 때문에 거부당했지만, 그 스킬로 무엇이든 만들 수 있다는 것을 모르고 🌍∞

title_i18n.ru: Тебя отвергли в гильдии из-за твоего навыка F-ранга, Не зная, что с его помощью ты можешь создать что угодно 🌍∞
